title: Binance MCP Server
snippet:
# Binance MCP Server
Binance MCP Server
Connect your AI agent to Binance with a single URL. Your agent can read market data, check balances, trade Spot / Margin / Convert / USDⓈ-M / COIN-M Futures, and move funds between wallets inside a dedicated Agentic sub-account — no local install, no API keys on your device.

## What's an MCP?
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI agents connect to external apps and services. Instead of just answering questions, an AI with MCP access can take actions on your behalf.
## What your agent can do
#### Check the market
"What’s the current BTCUSDT price and 24h change?" — tickers, order books, candlesticks, funding rates.
#### Check your balance
"Show my Agentic account balance across all wallets." — plus a read-only view of your main account.
#### Trade
"Buy $100 of BNB at market on spot." — Spot, Margin, Convert, USDⓈ-M Futures, and COIN-M Futures.
#### Move funds between wallets
"Move 2,000 USDT from my Spot wallet to my USDⓈ-M wallet." — inside your Agentic sub-account only.
## What your agent can access
When you connect, you choose which scopes to grant. Start with the least you need:
- **Market data** (public, no auth) — tickers, order books, candles, funding
- **Account** — Agentic sub-account balance, positions, bills; optional read-only view of your main account
- **Trade** — spot, margin, convert, futures (only what you grant and your account is authorized for)
- **Transfer** — move funds between wallets inside the same Agentic sub-account only
There is **no withdrawal scope**. Your agent can never move funds out of the sub-account to an external address.
## Before you start
1. Log in to [Binance.com](https://www.binance.com) in your desktop browser — this feature is built for desktop, not mobile.
2. Make sure the AI client you plan to use is installed and open: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex CLI, ChatGPT on the web, ChatGPT/Codex Desktop, VS Code, or Grok Bot.
### Don't paste the endpoint into a chat
Never paste the MCP endpoint into an AI chat and ask it to install the server, and never open the endpoint directly in your browser. Follow the setup steps for your client in the tabs below instead.

1. In your AI client's chat, enter: **"Use the Binance MCP Server to show the current BTCUSDT price and 24-hour change."**
2. Confirm the response shows the Binance MCP tool being used and returns live BTCUSDT market data.

title: Built for AI Agent Integration | Binance Blog
snippet:
The Binance MCP server currently supports trading and market-data capabilities, while on-chain and payment functionality can be integrated through other Binance APIs, tools, and skills.

Binance Agent OS is a gateway and toolkit for connecting AI agents to Binance. Our built-in MCP server currently supports trading and market data access, with payment and on-chain capabilities coming in future releases. In the meantime, developers can add these capabilities through other Agent OS tools.
## How to Connect Your AI Agent in Minutes
Connect your AI agent to Binance by adding the Binance MCP server to your agent environment, then authenticate it from your Binance account.
For Claude Code users:
1. **Add the MCP server.** Open your terminal, then copy and paste the following command:
*claude mcp add binance-mcp-server --transport http https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic*
2. **Open your agent environment** and enter /mcp. This lists your connected MCP servers, including binance-mcp-server.
3. **Start authentication.** Select binance-mcp-server and press Enter, then choose [Authenticate]. Your browser will redirect to an authentication page.
4. **Select your agent.** From the dropdown, choose which agent you want to connect to Binance.
5. **Set permissions.** Toggle which features and products this agent can access. Anything left off stays inaccessible until you enable it.
Return to your agent environment to configure trading parameters. You can review or change these permissions at any time under [Sub Accounts] → [Account Management].

title: What Is the Binance MCP Server? | Binance Support
snippet:
The Binance MCP Server is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint that lets MCP-compatible AI agents connect to Binance using a single URL and an authorization flow. Depending on the permissions you grant and your account eligibility, your agent can access market data, view account information for an Agentic sub-account, place supported trades, and transfer funds between wallets within the same Agentic sub-account.
#### **What is MCP?**
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that allows AI agents to connect to external applications and services through a structured tool interface. With MCP access, an AI agent can request data and, where permitted, initiate actions through connected services.
#### **What is the MCP endpoint URL?**
Use this endpoint URL in supported AI agents:
https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic
#### **Do you need to install anything locally or manage API keys?**
To connect, add the endpoint URL in your AI agent and complete an authorization flow. If your setup does not require locally generated API keys, do not store API keys on your device for this connection. Availability and exact steps vary by agent.

Based on the scopes you grant, your AI agent can typically:
- Read market data, such as tickers, order books, candlesticks, and funding rates.
- View balances and positions in your Agentic sub-account. Some setups may also provide a read-only view of certain main-account information, if enabled.
- Place trades for supported products, such as Spot, Margin, Convert, USDⓈ-M Futures, and COIN-M Futures, where available and authorized.
- Transfer funds between wallets within the same Agentic sub-account (for example, Spot Account to USDⓈ-M Account).

Currently the list of supported AI agents is: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Codex CLI, ChatGPT and VS Code.
#### **What is the fastest way to get set up?**
Use the MCP endpoint URL below in your AI agent, then complete authorization:
https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic
For agent-specific steps, follow the setup guide in the [official documentation](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/agent-native/mcp-server/agentic).
